# UI design review checklist

Use this generated checklist with the source trace and confidence level; it is not a compliance certificate.

- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTION-SHEETS-0001 — Choose or apply an action sheet — not an alert — to offer choices related to an intentional action in the documented context. (SHOULD, low; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/action-sheets))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTION-SHEETS-0002 — Choose or apply action sheets sparingly in the documented context. (SHOULD, low; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/action-sheets))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTION-SHEETS-0003 — Apply the documented Action sheets guidance to aim to keep titles short enough to display on a single line. (SHOULD, low; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/action-sheets))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTION-SHEETS-0004 — Make a message only if necessary available when applicable. (SHOULD, low; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/action-sheets))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTION-SHEETS-0005 — Apply the documented Action sheets guidance to make destructive choices visually prominent. (SHOULD, low; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/action-sheets))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTION-SHEETS-0006 — Choose or apply an action sheet — not a menu — to provide choices related to an action in the documented context. (SHOULD, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/action-sheets))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTION-SHEETS-0007 — Exclude letting an action sheet scroll from the applicable experience. (AVOID, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/action-sheets))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTION-SHEETS-0008 — Exclude displaying more than four buttons in an action sheet, including the Cancel button from the applicable experience. (AVOID, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/action-sheets))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0001 — Present activity rings when they’re relevant to the purpose of your app in the documented context. (SHOULD, low; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-rings))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0002 — Choose or apply activity rings only to show Move, Exercise, and Stand information in the documented context. (SHOULD, low; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-rings))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0003 — Choose or apply activity rings to show progress for a single person in the documented context. (SHOULD, low; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-rings))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0004 — Keep the visual appearance of Activity rings the same, regardless of where you display them in every applicable case. (MUST, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-rings))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0005 — Apply the documented Activity rings guidance to maintain Activity ring margins. (SHOULD, low; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-rings))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0006 — Exclude send notifications that repeat the same information the Activity app sends from the applicable experience. (AVOID, low; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-rings))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0007 — Exclude use Activity rings for decoration from the applicable experience. (AVOID, low; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-rings))

- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0009 — Do not alter Activity ring colors or opacity, including by applying filters. (MUST_NOT, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-rings))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0010 — Display Activity rings only on a black background. (MUST, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-rings))

- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0005 — Choose or apply the Share button to display an activity view in the documented context. (SHOULD, low; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-views))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0006 — Exclude placing a modal view above your extension from the applicable experience. (AVOID, low; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-views))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0007 — Choose or apply your main app to denote the progress of a lengthy operation in the documented context. (SHOULD, low; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-views))

- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ALERTS-0002 — Exclude using an alert merely to provide information from the applicable experience. (AVOID, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/alerts))

- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ALERTS-0004 — Exclude showing an alert when your app starts from the applicable experience. (AVOID, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/alerts))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ALERTS-0005 — Apply the documented Alerts guidance to write a title that clearly and succinctly describes the situation. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/alerts))

- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ALERTS-0007 — Exclude explaining alert buttons from the applicable experience. (AVOID, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/alerts))

- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ALERTS-0012 — Provide platform-appropriate keyboard, Home Screen, or remote actions for canceling an alert. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/alerts))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ALERTS-0013 — Choose or apply an action sheet — not an alert — to offer choices related to an intentional action in the documented context. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/alerts))
